newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE WELCOMES ALBANIAN PACT FOR FAIR ELECTIONS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE WELCOMES ALBANIAN PACT FOR FAIR ELECTIONS.

text.p: Greece welcomed on Tuesday an agreement between Albania's three main political parties for fair elections on Sunday and said Athens was closely following developments in the neighbouring Balkan country.
"Greece salutes the agreement achieved between Albania's three political parties for a normal election process and the recognition of the election result," the foreign ministry said in a statement.
"Greece feels that a successful election process is necessary for stability and democratic developments in Albania ... (Greece) will continue to closely watch how the situation develops," it said.
Albanian party leaders signed an agreement in Italy on Monday pledging to ensure free and fair elections and to work together for a stable government after the ballot.
They also agreed that the opposition would be given key supervisory posts in parliament.
Albania's south has been gripped by violence since March when thousands of civilians raided abandoned army barracks and seized weapons after the collapse of bogus investment schemes.
A multinational force of 7,000 has been deployed throughout the country to secure supply routes from armed gangs.
